comment: APK ReLab hand-checked vulnerable library versions. ranges are [from, to) pairs, empty string = unbounded. advisory=true means a general notice, not a CVE.

vulns.summary: Log4Shell: remote code execution through JNDI lookups in logged messages
vulns.note: Rare on Android; it matters only if untrusted text is logged through Log4j.

vulns.summary: incomplete Log4Shell fix (lookup bypass) and denial of service through recursive lookups
Text4Shell: StringSubstitutor interpolation can run script / DNS / URL lookups on untrusted input
vulns.note: Exploitable only if untrusted text goes through StringSubstitutor.createInterpolator().

vulns.summary: certificate pinning can be bypassed by a man-in-the-middle
certificate pinning can be bypassed by a man-in-the-middle
denial of service while deserializing untrusted JSON (unbounded recursion)
polymorphic deserialization gadget chains: a JSON payload from the network can run code when default typing (or an open @JsonTypeInfo) is enabled
vulns.fixed: 2.9.10.8 or newer (and never enable default typing for untrusted input)
vulns.note: Exploitable only when default typing / polymorphic handling is turned on for attacker-controlled JSON.

vulns.summary: this Jackson line is behind a long series of deserialization and denial-of-service fixes
this OkHttp 3.x release predates the modern TLS defaults and is no longer fixed
crafted archive (7z/TAR) exhausts CPU or memory while unpacking (denial of service); classic Zip Slip sink when entries are extracted without path checks
infinite loop / out-of-memory while unpacking a crafted archive
ZipUtil.unpack writes entries outside the target directory when the archive contains ../ paths
the MAC of an AES-encrypted zip entry is not always verified when decrypting, so a tampered archive can be accepted
Files.createTempDir gives world-readable temp folders (local information disclosure on shared devices)
denial of service while parsing a crafted message
denial of service while parsing a crafted message
cross-site scripting when cleaning crafted HTML
denial of service through deeply nested JSON (stack overflow)
unsafe deserialization gadget chain (InvokerTransformer)
vulns.note: Exploitable only if the app deserializes untrusted data with ObjectInputStream.

vulns.summary: unsafe deserialization gadget chain (InvokerTransformer)
vulns.note: Exploitable only if the app deserializes untrusted data with ObjectInputStream.

vulns.summary: path traversal through a user-controlled @Path parameter (../ is not neutralised)
HTTP request smuggling through control characters in header names
Play Core local code execution: another app can make this app load its code
vulns.fixed: 1.7.2 or newer (the library is also deprecated)

vulns.summary: timing side channel in ECDSA signature verification
Heartbleed: the server or client leaks process memory (keys, session data)
infinite loop while parsing a crafted certificate (denial of service)
this OpenSSL branch (1.0.x / 1.1.0 or older) has not received security fixes for years
OpenSSL 1.1.1 reached end of life in September 2023
heap buffer overflow in the SOCKS5 proxy handshake (long host name)
vulns.note: Reachable only when the app uses curl through a SOCKS5 proxy.

vulns.summary: memory corruption while compressing input with many distant matches
heap overflow in inflate() with a large gzip header extra field
vulns.note: Reachable only when the code calls inflateGetHeader().

vulns.summary: use-after-free in png_image_free
